verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com. It exposes API read/write, analytics, documentation-search and planning tools, uses OAuth with session revocation, admin controls and Workbench call logs, and requires human confirmation for risky writes. One-command agent plugins cover Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and a live probe confirms the remote server is up and OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec. Missing for 10: an independent or hands-on report of an agent connecting and completing tool calls end to end (the probe only verifies the auth handshake).
